scope: Russian-only supplemental acquisition, complete native metadata, lossless compressed source archives
priority: The seven user-requested families remain primary; supplemental small research corpora do not replace their full imports

language_policy.mixed_or_unknown_sources: Retain earlier source audits and archives separately; do not publish them as Russian-only data or inflate Russian hours

metadata_policy.missing_fields: Explicitly absent or unverified; never fabricate metadata
metadata_policy.anonymized_labels: Keep separate from original verbatim transcripts; do not replace original audio labels with anonymized words
metadata_policy.source_layout: Separate source and immutable release prefix; original native archive hierarchy retained
metadata_policy.manifests: Source URLs, bytes, file checksums, provenance and transfer receipts accompany the native archives

compression_policy.wrapper: tar.zst for bundled native source files and metadata
compression_policy.existing_compressed_files: Retain original OPUS/FLAC/MP3/ZIP/gzip/Parquet bytes; do not decode and re-encode audio
compression_policy.large_inflight_imports: Original pinned transfers continue with their native formats; completion and compression are recorded separately
compression_policy.verification: Exact source byte counts, upstream checksum when supplied, native ZIP CRC, SHA256 before/after packing, zstd integrity, archive membership and complete S3 readback SHA256
compression_policy.cleanup: Remove only newly created temporary archive after complete verified S3 readback; original source files remain
compression_policy.private_paths: Directories 0700 and files 0600 explicitly; do not rely on inherited mount ACLs
